name: pdf
description: PDF production skills and a PDF viewer panel, published as an official CodeFusion plugin.

description_i18n.en: PDF production skills: typeset and render reports, resumes, posters, and covers to PDF. View PDFs in a side panel: reference passages in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture pages.
description_i18n.zh-CN: PDF creation skills: typesetting and rendering output for reports, resumes, posters, and covers; view PDFs in the sidebar, quote content into the conversation, and enable the Agent to read, search, locate highlights, and capture pages.
